# Version 3.119.5 (Unreleased)
> **Apple platform and WinUI fixes**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.119.5 backports Apple platform TFM alignment and fixes the WinUI Projection DLL on .NET 9.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **WinUI Projection DLL not found on .NET 9** — The WinUI Projection assembly is now packaged so .NET 9 consumers can load it without a DllNotFoundException at startup. ([#4086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4086))

## Platform

- **Apple TFM alignment: versioned library TFMs and unversioned app TFMs** — Backports the Apple TFM changes from main so that libraries target versioned Apple TFMs (26.0) and sample apps use the unversioned forms, matching current .NET SDK guidance. — ❤️ [@drasticactions](https://github.com/drasticactions) ([#4579](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4579))
